text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: median over the 8 Primary substations of each Primary's median path error (mean absolute error of the weekly capacity path against the known path, as a share of its mean) on the scoring units (Solar farms D, E, and F, 4 path seeds). Line: 95% interval from resampling Primaries, then farm-seed units within each. Dashed line: 0.15, the plan's ceiling for ramps and steps. All rows are exploratory except the frozen asymmetric fit's ramps and steps.'
